info.title: Socials Homes API
info.summary: Public, read-only: supported cities, plans and prices, and live rental listing counts. No authentication.
info.description:
Public, read-only data from Socials Homes, a rental listing alert service for people moving to a new city: the cities it covers, its plans and prices in EUR, and live rental listing counts per city and budget. The same data the website, its markdown pages and the Socials Homes MCP servers serve.

## Authentication

None. Every endpoint is public and anonymous: there are no accounts, API keys, OAuth clients or scopes, so `security` is empty. Send no credentials.

## Safe to call

Nothing in this API writes. Every operation is a GET; POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE answer 405. There is no separate sandbox because there is nothing to protect production from: call https://www.socials.homes directly while you build.

## Rate limits

300 requests per 60 seconds per IP address, shared by every /api/v1 endpoint; the supply endpoint also counts against 600 requests per 3600 seconds per IP address, on top of the api limit. Every endpoint response carries the IETF RateLimit-Policy and RateLimit headers (and RateLimit-Limit, -Remaining and -Reset). Over a limit the answer is 429 with Retry-After. Limits are counted per server instance, so treat them as ceilings.

## Errors

Every error is an RFC 9457 problem (application/problem+json) with type, title, status, detail, a machine-readable code and a resolution hint. Codes: invalid_parameter, not_found, city_not_found, method_not_allowed, rate_limited, internal_error. Each type URI links to its section of https://www.socials.homes/developers#errors.

## Pagination

listCities is cursor-paginated: pass next_cursor back as cursor until it is null. limit is 1 to 200, default 50. The Link header carries rel="next".

## Versioning and deprecation

The major version is in the path (/api/v1) and in the X-API-Version header. Within v1, changes are additive only: new endpoints, new optional parameters, new fields. Clients must ignore fields they do not know. A breaking change ships as /api/v2, announced in the changelog at https://www.socials.homes/developers#changelog at least 90 days before v1 changes or stops; during that time v1 keeps working and its responses carry Deprecation and Sunset headers. Current version 1.0.1, released 2026-10-14.

get.summary: Count live rental listings in a city, optionally at or under a monthly budget
get.description: How many live rental listings Socials Homes counts in a city right now and, with budget_max_eur, how many are at or under that monthly rent. The counts come from the same cache the signup funnel uses, refreshed about every 10 minutes, and cover the sites Socials Homes scans, so alerts can bring more. When counts are unavailable the answer says so (available: false) and never reports zero. This endpoint also counts against the supply rate limit. Read-only.

200.description: The counts, or a plain statement that they are unavailable.

data.note: These are the listings Socials Homes counts in its own copy of the market; some housing sites are not counted here, so alerts can bring more. Counts refresh about every 10 minutes and change as homes are let.

unavailable.summary: Counts unavailable, which is not zero

supply.reason: Live counts for this city are not available right now. That does not mean there are no homes: some housing sites are not counted here.

get.summary: List the plans with EUR prices, billing, renewal, inclusions and the VIP guarantee
get.description: Every plan on sale with its EUR price as checkout charges it, how it bills, whether and at what price it renews, what it includes, how cancelling works, and the VIP Keys Pass guarantee with its conditions and terms link. Read-only.

data.name: Explorer
data.billing: €24.95 today, then it renews automatically every month at €24.95 until you cancel.
includes: Listings matched to your city, budget and move-in date, sent the moment they go live, on WhatsApp and in the web app
Exclusive discount codes on listings from housing partners
Support on WhatsApp and by email

If you have not found a home when your plan ends, you can ask for one free extension by email before or within 7 days after it expires; it is granted at Socials' discretion, one per subscription (Terms 5.2)

data.name: Seeker
data.billing: €39.90 every 2 months (€19.95 a month), renewing automatically every 2 months until you cancel.
includes: Listings matched to your city, budget and move-in date, sent the moment they go live, on WhatsApp and in the web app
Exclusive discount codes on listings from housing partners
Support on WhatsApp and by email

If you have not found a home when your plan ends, you can ask for one free extension by email before or within 7 days after it expires; it is granted at Socials' discretion, one per subscription (Terms 5.2)

data.name: VIP Keys Pass, 3 months
data.billing: €94.95 today covers the first 3 months, then it renews automatically at €94.95 a month until you cancel.
includes: A personal housing expert: a kick-off call to plan your search, help with your replies to landlords, checks on a landlord before you pay, and a read of your contract before you sign

guarantee.summary: If you have not signed a lease within 90 days of buying the VIP Keys Pass, what you paid at purchase is refunded (€94.95 for 3 months, €189.95 for Lifetime) and your expert keeps helping you for free until you move in. Conditions apply.

data.name: VIP Keys Pass, Lifetime
data.billing: €189.95 once. It never renews: your alerts continue and your expert helps you until you move in.
includes: A personal housing expert: a kick-off call to plan your search, help with your replies to landlords, checks on a landlord before you pay, and a read of your contract before you sign

guarantee.summary: If you have not signed a lease within 90 days of buying the VIP Keys Pass, what you paid at purchase is refunded (€94.95 for 3 months, €189.95 for Lifetime) and your expert keeps helping you for free until you move in. Conditions apply.

value.prices_note: Prices are in euros and include VAT where applicable. Checkout may show the amount in your local currency.
value.cancellation: Cancel anytime in the app and you are never billed again. Cancelling stops future renewals; your access runs to the end of the period you already paid for.
value.refunds: Payments are not refundable (Terms 5.1), except the VIP Keys Pass guarantee (Terms 5.5) and the 14-day right of withdrawal from the VIP expert service (Terms 5.6).

vip_guarantee.summary: If you have not signed a lease within 90 days of buying the VIP Keys Pass, what you paid at purchase is refunded (€94.95 for 3 months, €189.95 for Lifetime) and your expert keeps helping you for free until you move in. Conditions apply.
conditions: Book your 15-minute kick-off call with your expert within 48 hours of purchase
Keep your search budget within the range you agree with your expert
Apply within 24 hours to the listings sent to you that match the criteria you agreed with your expert
vip_guarantee.how_to_claim: Claim from day 80 after purchase until 14 days after the 90 days end, by emailing hello@socials.homes. One claim per person.

City.description: A city Socials Homes covers. The slug is the identifier every endpoint and the signup funnel use.

slug.description: Lowercase, digits and underscores, for example the_hague.

links.description: Where to go next for this city.

supply.description: Live listing counts for this city.

signup.description: The signup funnel with this city selected. The person sets up their own search there; this API never creates one.

CityList.description: One page of cities, ordered by slug.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to get the next page. Null on the last page.

SupplyAvailable.description: Live counts are available for this city.

live_listings.description: Live listings Socials Homes counts in this city right now, at any price.

budget_max_eur.description: The budget asked for, or null when none was given.

listings_within_budget.description: Live listings at or under the budget. Listings without a stated price are included, as they are in alerts. Null without a budget.

level.description: How the budget reads: critical (under 5 listings), low (5 to 15) or ok (16 or more). Null without a budget.

suggested_budget_eur.description: A budget that would reach about 30 listings when the market is thin at the asked budget, rounded up to the nearest 50. Null when the budget is fine or no budget would help.

SupplyUnavailable.description: Live counts are not available for this city right now. This never means zero homes: some housing sites are not counted here.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence to pass on as written.
examples: Live counts for this city are not available right now. That does not mean there are no homes: some housing sites are not counted here.

Supply.description: The live count, or a plain statement that it is unavailable. Unavailable is never reported as zero.

SupplyResponse.description: Live listing counts for one city.

data.description: The city, its counts and what the counts cover.

note.description: What the counts cover: the listings Socials Homes counts in its own copy of the market, refreshed about every 10 minutes.

signup_url.description: The signup funnel with this city selected.

Guarantee.description: The VIP guarantee, in short, with the link to its full terms.

summary.description: The guarantee in a sentence, with its conditions noted.

url.description: The guarantee's section of the terms.

Plan.description: One plan, priced in EUR, as checkout charges it.

id.description: Plan identifier. Today: explorer, seeker, vip-3-months, vip-lifetime. An open set: new plans may appear within v1.

path.description: Search on your own (on_your_own) or with a personal housing expert (with_an_expert). An open set.

price_eur.description: What is charged at purchase, in EUR.

billing.description: How the charge recurs, in words a person reads.

billing_interval.description: The billing shape. Today: "month", "2 months", "3 months, then monthly", "one-time". An open set: read billing for the words.

auto_renews.description: Whether the plan renews automatically until cancelled.

renewal_price_eur.description: What each renewal charges, in EUR. Null for a one-time payment.

renews_every.description: The renewal interval, today "month" or "2 months". Null for a one-time payment.

per_month_eur.description: The honest per-month figure for the first term. Null for Lifetime.

guarantee.description: The VIP guarantee, or null for plans without one.

VipGuarantee.description: The VIP Keys Pass 90-day guarantee with its conditions.

conditions.description: What the buyer must do for the guarantee to apply.

url.description: The guarantee's section of the terms.

PlansResponse.description: Every plan on sale, with the terms that apply to all of them.

ApiIndex.description: What this API is and where everything is.

version.description: The major version in the path.

spec_version.description: SemVer of the v1 contract, as in info.version.

authentication.description: How to authenticate: you do not.

required.description: No authentication exists or is needed.

url.description: The absolute URL, as an RFC 6570 URI template where the path has {slug}.

name.description: The policy name used in the RateLimit headers: today "api" and "supply".

items.description: One MCP server with the same data.

message.description: What is wrong and what is accepted.

CitySuggestion.description: A covered city close to what was asked for.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem details object. Every error this API returns has this shape, served as application/problem+json.

type.description: Identifies the problem type and dereferences to its documentation.

title.description: A short summary of the problem type.

detail.description: What went wrong with this request.

instance.description: The path of the request that failed.

code.description: A machine-readable error code. Every code listed here keeps its meaning within v1; a new one may be added, so handle an unknown code by its HTTP status.

suggestions.description: Close matches, on city_not_found or a malformed slug.

allowed_methods.description: The methods this path accepts, on method_not_allowed.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait, on rate_limited. The Retry-After header carries the same value.

slug.name: slug
slug.description: The city's slug from listCities: lowercase, digits and underscores (the_hague, not the-hague).

limit.name: limit
limit.description: How many cities per page, from 1 to 200. Default 50.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, passed as it is. Opaque: do not build or change one. Leave it out for the first page.

country.name: country
country.description: Only cities in this country: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("NL") or an English or common name ("Netherlands", "Holland", "UK"). A country with no covered city returns an empty page.

budget_max_eur.name: budget_max_eur
budget_max_eur.description: Maximum monthly rent in EUR, a whole number from 50 to 20000. With it, the answer also counts the listings at or under it.

RateLimit-Policy.description: The rate limit policies this request counts against (draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers): name, quota q and window w in seconds. "api" on every endpoint, "supply" as well on the supply endpoint.

RateLimit.description: What is left of each policy: remaining requests r and seconds t until the window resets.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the window of the policy closest to running out (earlier draft field).

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in that window (earlier draft field).

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until that window resets (earlier draft field).

Link.description: RFC 8288 links: rel="next" to the next page on listCities, and on every JSON and problem response rel="service-desc" (this document) and rel="service-doc" (the docs).

Cache-Control.description: How long the answer may be reused.

Deprecation.description: Not sent today. Sent (RFC 9745) once this endpoint or version is deprecated, at least 90 days before it stops working.

Sunset.description: Not sent today. Sent (RFC 8594) with the date a deprecated endpoint or version stops working.

changes: The official JavaScript SDK and CLI, the socials-homes package on npm: see SDKs and CLI
The OpenAPI document writes every error response out on its operation, typed as Problem. No response changed
First release of the public REST API: GET /api/v1, /api/v1/cities, /api/v1/cities/{slug}, /api/v1/cities/{slug}/supply and /api/v1/plans
OpenAPI 3.1 document at /openapi.json and /api/openapi.yaml, and an RFC 9727 API catalog at /.well-known/api-catalog
RFC 9457 problem details on every error, IETF RateLimit headers on every endpoint response
